listing: sublet jan-apr room in house on columbia st w near uw. 780 dollars a month. utilities incl wifi incl. 5 min walk to campus. quiet street. no smoking pls. just be clean and chill. our house at 305 columbia st w waterloo. 3 of us rent it from a landlord who lives out in cambridge. text for pics and we can book a viewing for a day u can come. also landlord said sublets are fine if we send him your name and student id. thx
label_rationale: Lowercase run-on style. Address, viewing, plausible price, off-site landlord who accepts sublets (RTA s.97(1)). The landlord asking for the subtenant's name and student ID to approve a sublet is a normal consent step, not an early ID/SIN harvest (CAFC bulletin warns about 'rental questionnaire' collecting banking details, income and more before any showing; here no banking/SIN data is requested and the viewing is first). ADMIT. Uncertainty: a scam model that over-weights 'student id' could misfire.
